title: Web Summit 2026: Brasil chega a Lisboa com 200 empresas à procura de investimento (IOL)
what_it_says: IOL (with Link to Leaders, from an ApexBrasil statement) splits the delegation: 99 companies selected for Web Summit's official programme, 90 nominated by partner entities, 50 linked to ten tech hubs. These add to 239, not the headline 200. IOL names four hubs: Porto Digital, ACATE, SENAI CIMATEC and Instituto Caldeira. ApexBrasil says Brazil has more than 13,000 active startups; Brazilian companies raised about US$700 million at earlier editions through contacts made there.
